run.reward: decision turns of week N scored by the discounted valuation change over weeks N..N+3 (valuation = cash + engine MRR x 7/30 x min(weeks left, 26)), clipped at +-0.05 and divided by the running median magnitude (floor 0.003), capped at +-3
run.stack: resident actor+critic, 16k micro-batches, 24k train window, pacer batch 8 / 1200 s, critic warm-started from an earlier episode's critic
